verses.mystical_translation: the Living Presence hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the the Divine of Jacob defend thee;
Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion, the holy center;
Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
We will rejoice in thy deliverance and wholeness, and in the name of our the Divine we will set up our banners: the Living Presence fulfil all thy petitions.
Now know I that the Living Presence saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the Living Presence our the Divine.
They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
Save, the Living Presence: let the king hear us when we call.

contemplative_note: What a community trusts in reveals more than the banners it raises.
safety_note: Royal military prayer is not an endorsement of nationalism or war; the psalm explicitly relativizes weapons and military power.
